justiceLines.text: Word reaches you, days late: Wanda stands accused over what happened to Marcus. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
⚖ Wanda blocks your path. "We need to talk about the stores. About what you've been taking." A few others are watching, not approaching. "Make it right, or leave. Your call."
(Find them and answer — pay restitution, or refuse. Attacking them answers too.)
Marcus is gone — the moot doesn't try the dead. The cases die with the accused; the fire remembers the rest.
[policy] refused the confrontation (justiceRespond -> {"refused":true})
Word reaches you, days late: Marcus stands accused over what happened to Wanda. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
⚖ Wanda looks around the fire. "The stores. The counts. All of it — in the open. There's a moot."
📓 Codex: They demanded a moot. Formal. No more hallway justice.

🔴 LIVE BREAKING NEWS! A MOOT has been CALLED! WANDA points at YOU — THEFT — TAKING WHAT WASN'T THEIRS! The gamblers are SCRAMBLING! Your CASE FILE is ready — check it before the fire decides your fate!
Wanda stands up at the fire, pointing. "This one. Theft — taking what wasn't theirs — and we all know it." Heads turn. 2 days until the moot. Use them.
Word reaches you, days late: Marcus stands accused over what happened to Wanda. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.

Shannon corners you by the fire. "We all eat from the same pot. You've been taking more than you bring for a while now. That can't continue — the village will decide." (Warning: pull weight or face a moot.)
👀 Lena starts a story with "back when I was an electrician..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.

◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a gift.
🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
Wanda calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
🔴 LIVE — THE VERDICT IS IN! The galaxy holds its breath!
Shannon counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "9 for guilty. 0 against."
A pause long enough to live in. Someone's breath catches. Then: "Guilty." Nobody looks at anybody.
The sentence is spoken low, like something heavy set down. "You pay. And stay — this time."
Hands: 9 for exile, 0 against.
Exiled. You leave with what you carry — nothing more. Behind you, Haven keeps its fire. Ahead: the world, which just got much bigger.
📓 Codex: Exiled (moot). Walking.
